title: 第11章 入伍第一天，火线提干
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 点验结束后，各班新兵回到宿舍内。在班长的带领下，大家简单做了个自我介绍，算是相互了解，接着便开始分配床铺和储物柜。丁腾飞正巧分到了陆阳的上铺，这样让他觉得跟这个“喜欢假用功”的老乡愈发投缘。周凯东冷着脸，严肃的说：“我丑话说在前头，不管你们某些人在外面是什么德行，进来部队就必须按照部队的规矩来！”“那些个坏习惯，坏毛病，统统给我收起来。谁敢在我面前炸刺，我就削谁，听懂了吗？”“是。”大家心里头跟明镜似的，自然知道这番话是在点丁腾飞。谁家正常人，会随身携带甩棍，指虎，蝴蝶刀这些东西？但丁腾飞却丝毫没把周凯东的警告放在心上，甚至有些瞧不上这个小小的三期士官。在新兵连，谁是大小王他还是分得清的，连长指导员那种带星星的说话才好事。至于双枪带拐的老兵士官，压根没必要放在心上。新兵连三个月一过还得分班，到时候谁还认识谁啊？......紧跟着，周凯东开始分配任务，全体大扫除。营房空置了很长一阵，落满灰尘，自然需要人来打扫。三班负责宿舍内，门前走廊的卫生，还被临时分配到了，宿舍楼一二层厕所清洁工作。部队里搞卫生，要求可比家里严格太多，看见看不见的地方都得一尘不染，瓷砖和栏杆也得用清洁球刷的亮堂堂。甚至有些瓷砖缝隙，都得用毛刷刷的一干二净才行。陆阳和丁腾飞领到工具，被分配去打扫卫生间。但相比陆阳的干活麻利，踏实认真，丁腾飞则显得吊儿郎当。拿着个墩布在地上鬼画符，有人来了装模作样拖两下，没人瞧见直接摆烂罢工，就这还叫苦叫累。尤其是，当他瞧见陆阳竟然蹲在地上，用清洁球仔仔细细清理坑道时，更是露出一副强烈的嫌弃。“喂，差不多行了，又没人看见，用不着装的那么认真？”陆阳并未理会，在部队打扫卫生就是这么个标准。想要当好一个兵，那就得从每一件小事开始。你糊弄部队，部队就会糊弄你，最后服役期限到了，一脚把你给踹出去。他严肃对待，认真完成班长交代的任务，也是为自已为难的军旅生涯负责。丁腾飞凑到陆阳身旁：“哎，先前没问完呢，你哪个高中的？”“城南。”“哎哟卧槽，你是城南高中的？”丁腾飞一下子就激动起来：“高三九班的王强，你认识吗？”“不认识。”“王强你都不认识，那小子不是你们学校扛把子吗，天天骑摩托车上学的？”其实王强这个名字，陆阳高中时是听说过的。在这个大多数学生都乖乖骑自行车，少部分骑电动车的时代。能够骑着摩托车来上学，还算是一件比较拉风的事儿。再加上那家伙痞里痞气，经常放学和校外黄毛厮混，自然在学校里也比较出名。但后来，据说是犯了什么事，被逮进去了.......好像是偷电瓶？丁腾飞很是嘚瑟：“王强那呆逼以前被我按在地上揍过，想跟我混来着，我没搭理他。家里穷的一笔，路边给人修自行车的，还特么天天骑个二手破摩托显摆。”“对了，你们学校学播音主持班有个叫李什么倩的，吊女的打过胎你知道吗，之前还追过我.....”丁腾飞眉飞色舞的讲述着他在外头的那些光辉事迹，想要借机引起陆阳的崇拜。这招，在懵懂无知的高中校园里，对付那些乖乖仔确实挺唬人。但很可惜，重生归来心智早已健全的陆阳这听到这些，只觉得幼稚可笑。先不说，对方口中这些事，究竟有多少水分。能堂而皇之，把低俗暴力当做炫耀资本，只能说明素质差。这就像是那些个纹龙画虎，深夜里骑着鬼火和改装摩托车炸街的精神小伙。他们或许觉得这是酷，是帅，是张扬个性，甚至会觉得能迷倒一群小姑娘。但在路人视角下，只会觉得厌恶鄙夷，甚至会希望这些没素质的炸街党，路的尽头是天堂.......忽然，丁腾飞鬼鬼祟祟的去外头瞅了眼，确认没人后立马跑回来。躲到蹲坑最后一排，从袜子里翻一根皱巴巴的烟，用火机点着。然后半蹲着身子，一脸享受的吞云吐雾。陆阳皱眉：“别把烟灰弹到瓷砖上，我刚刷过的！”丁腾飞一脸的没好气：“我说你这人怎么这么死脑筋？大扫除这东西，大差不差的就行了，那么认真做给谁看？”“妈的，我是真烦这鬼地方，要不是我老子给我把信用卡停了，非逼着我来当兵，我特么死也不会跑这来受罪。”“咱俩是老乡，别说我不照顾你，回头退伍了跟我混。把你退伍费给我，咱俩一块创业，人脉路子我这都有，保证带你赚大钱！”陆阳都被逗笑了，这才刚入伍，就盯上自已的退伍费了？“不用了，我没打算当两年兵就退伍。”“咋的，你还真准备在这长待啊？”丁腾飞用一副过来人的语气说道，指手画脚的说道。“先不说你那考学能不能考得上，就算考上了又能怎么样？”“当个小军官，能有什么前途，到岁数了该退伍不还得退伍？”“还不如趁早出来创业做生意，我老子初中都没上完，现在照样开路虎。”“我都想好了，回头出去以后先搞个奶茶店，这玩意儿现在是风口，纯暴利行业，几毛钱的珍珠奶茶能卖到六七块！”“不然搞个理发店也行，我好几个弟兄都是学美容美发的，那玩意儿不光来钱，妞是一点儿不少泡，尤其开在技校附近的！”说到这，丁腾飞叼着烟，露出一脸的猥琐坏笑。当下，智能机还没出现，正是非主流横行霸道的年代。什么“你折我翅膀，我毁你天堂”正是当下最流行的爆款说说。一头夸张的爆炸菊花头，是年轻男生的标配；至于女生则追求齐刘海，锡纸烫，定位烫，以及亚麻色染烫。正因如此，托尼老师才成了走在时尚前沿的弄潮儿，能够接触到青春叛逆的小姑娘自然也很多。而陆阳以过来人的视角再看这些东西，只觉羞耻症都要犯了，鸡皮疙瘩掉一地。尤其是当他点开自已的QQ空间，看着里头一条条中二火星文说说，更是有种想要扇自已两巴掌的冲动......“你说的这些，我都不感兴趣，我只想当好我的兵。”“随你便，反正我也是好意，你抓不住机会，别怨我。”丁腾飞耸耸肩，觉得陆阳还是缺少格局，所以不敢勇敢迈出那一步：“对了，你以后少跟孔垄接触，我看那傻逼不爽！”陆阳直接被他给逗笑了：有没有一种可能，我看你这个傻逼，也挺不爽的？成年人的思维，让他养成了喜怒不形于色的习惯。既然知道对方是什么德行，也就没必要去理会。对于这类人最好的方式就是无视，因为你越是搭理，他越来劲。这时，外头突然传来一阵急促的脚步声，吓得丁腾飞赶紧把烟头丢进坑道里，装模作样的拿起清洁球开始擦拭地砖。可当他发现来人竟是隔壁班的新兵，立马摆出一副凶神恶煞的样子，冲着那人骂骂咧咧。“妈的，没看到我们在这搞卫生，拉屎去外头大厕所拉去！”“我，我就尿个尿。”“尿尿也不行，老子刚拖干净，回头检查不合格算你的？”那个新兵明显是个老实孩子，吓得赶紧到别处找厕所去。对于劳动成果的保护方面，至少这家伙做的还算到位。但陆阳清楚，这家伙并非是出于义气，只是想要共享他的劳动成果罢了。......卫生工作结束时，陆阳累的满头是汗，而丁腾飞为了展现劳动辛苦，也强行往脑袋上衣领上撒了点水。不得不说，这家伙小聪明还是有的，知道什么时候该偷懒，什么时候该表现。往回走时，班长周凯东已经戴上白手套，开始检查起了宿舍内的卫生情况。只是简单在门头，床板背后用手指抹了一下，白色的指尖就立即变成了灰色。周凯东冷哼：“这就是你们打扫的成果，一个小时就给我忙出这样的结果？”“报告！”就在孔垄等人瑟瑟发抖的等着挨批时，陆阳和丁腾飞正巧从外头回来。周凯东头也不回：“进来！”可就在二人从他面前经过时，周凯东鼻子敏锐的嗅到了点什么，立马命令二人站住。他凑到二人中间闻了闻，冷冷的问了句：“抽烟了？”丁腾飞立马否认：“报告，不是我抽的！”周凯东眯起眼睛，将目光投向陆阳。陆阳：“报告，我没有抽烟的习惯。”他前世确实抽烟，但后来欠一屁股债，就给借了。要是强行给，也能抽，但基本上属于没瘾的那种。周凯东没有废话，直接将目标锁定在丁腾飞身上，命令他张嘴哈一口气。但这小子贼的很，抽完烟后用水漱口好几遍，这会儿已经没什么烟味了。可周凯东的下一个动作，却直接让丁腾飞原形毕露，指尖他抓起对方手指闻了闻，那是一股新鲜醇厚的尼古丁味道。“丁腾飞留下，其余人滚去走廊站着。”“是！”孔垄庆幸逃过一劫，赶紧推着陆阳往外走。还非常贴心的，捎带着关上宿舍门。透过即将闭合的门缝，看着丁腾飞不断后退的脚步，以及苍白恐惧的脸色，陆阳已经猜到接下来要发生点儿什么了。【检测到新知识点：提*干！】【知识点分析：广义上指从士兵提升为军官干部，另一层含义则是物理层面上，与吊杠有异曲同工之妙！】......几分钟后，宿舍门再度被打开。周凯东一边系着武装带，一边走出来。陆阳等人探头朝着门里瞧了眼，看到地上那朵光荣入伍的大红花已经被蹂躏的变了形，纷纷倒吸大口凉气。当什么都不能当刺头，惹什么都不能惹班长，抽什么都不能抽烟，不然下场老惨了......周凯东冷哼一声：“拿着你们的被子滚到走廊上，接下来教你们整理内务，动作快！”
content_en: After the inspection, each class of recruits returned to their dormitories.Under the leadership of the squad leader, everyone briefly introduced themselves to get to know each other, and then began to allocate beds and lockers.Ding Tengfei happened to be assigned to Lu Yang's upper bunk, which made him feel closer to this fellow who "liked to fake hard work".Zhou Kaidong had a cold face and said seriously: "I'm going to say something ugly first. No matter what kind of virtue some of you are outside, you must follow the rules of the army when you come into the army!" "I will put away all those bad habits and bad habits. I will cut off anyone who dares to explode in front of me, do you understand?" "Yes." Everyone was like a mirror in their hearts, and naturally knew that these words were a sign of success.Who in their right mind would carry around things like a swinging stick, a pointing tiger, and a butterfly knife?But Ding Tengfei didn't take Zhou Kaidong's warning to heart at all, and even looked down upon this little third-term sergeant.In the recruit company, he can still tell who is the big king and the big king. It is a good thing for the company commander and instructor to talk like stars.As for the veteran non-commissioned officer with two guns and a kidnapping, there is no need to take it to heart at all.The recruits are still assigned to their respective classes after three months. Who will know whom by then?...Following that, Zhou Kaidong began to assign tasks and clean up everyone.The barracks had been vacant for a long time and were covered with dust. Naturally, they needed someone to clean them.The third class is responsible for the sanitation of the dormitory and the corridor in front of the door, and was temporarily assigned to clean the toilets on the first and second floors of the dormitory building.Hygiene requirements in the army are much stricter than at home. Everything visible and invisible must be spotless, and tiles and railings must be polished with a cleaning ball.Even some gaps in the tiles have to be cleaned with a brush.Lu Yang and Ding Tengfei received the tools and were assigned to clean the bathroom.But compared to Lu Yang, who works quickly and conscientiously, Ding Tengfei seems carefree.He took a mop and drew talismans on the ground. Someone came and pretended to drag it for a few times, but no one saw it and just put it on the ground. He was still complaining about being tired.Especially when he saw Lu Yang squatting on the ground and carefully cleaning the tunnel with a cleaning ball, he showed strong disgust."Hey, it's almost done, and no one saw it, so why don't you dress so seriously?" Lu Yang ignored it. This is the standard for cleaning in the army.If you want to be a good soldier, you have to start with every little thing.If you fool the troops, the troops will fool you. When your final term of service is up, they will kick you out.He took it seriously and completed the tasks assigned by the squad leader, and he also took responsibility for his own embarrassing military career.Ding Tengfei came close to Lu Yang: "Hey, I didn't finish asking earlier, which high school are you from?" "Chengnan." "Oh shit, you are from Chengnan High School?" Ding Tengfei suddenly became excited: "Do you know Wang Qiang from Class 9, Grade 3?" "No." "You don't even know Wang Qiang. Isn't that kid the leader of your school? He rides a motorcycle to school every day?" In fact, Lu Yang had heard of the name Wang Qiang in high school.In this era, most students ride bicycles obediently, and a few ride electric scooters.Being able to ride a motorcycle to school is quite cool.In addition, that guy is very naughty and often hangs out with young people outside the school after school, so naturally he is quite famous in the school.But later, it was said that he had committed something and was arrested... It seemed like he was stealing batteries?Ding Tengfei was very angry: "I have pushed that idiot Wang Qiang to the ground and beat him before. He wanted to hang out with me, but I ignored him. My family is very poor, and there is a man who repairs bicycles on the roadside, and he rides a second-hand motorcycle every day to show off." "By the way, you.There is a girl named Li Heqian in the broadcasting and hosting class in our school. She had an abortion, you know, and she even chased me before..." Ding Teng talked about his glorious deeds outside with great joy, hoping to take the opportunity to arouse Lu Yang's admiration.This trick is really quite intimidating to deal with those obedient boys in an ignorant high school campus.But it's a pity that Lu Yang, who had already regained his mental health after being reborn, only felt childish and ridiculous when he heard this.Let’s not talk about how much water there is in these things in the other party’s mouth.To be able to act openly and use vulgar violence as bragging rights only shows poor quality.This is like one of those spirited guys with dragons and tigers who ride wildfires and modified motorcycles to blast the streets late at night.They may think it's cool, handsome, flamboyant, or even that it can charm a group of little girls.But from the perspective of passers-by, they would only feel disgust and contempt, and even hope that there is paradise at the end of the road for these unqualified street bombers... Suddenly, Ding Tengfei sneakily took a look outside, and immediately ran back after confirming that no one was there.He hid in the last row of the squatting pit, dug a crumpled cigarette out of his sock, and lit it with a lighter.Then he half-crouched and puffed away with enjoyment.Lu Yang frowned: "Don't flick cigarette ashes on the tiles, I just painted them!" Ding Tengfei looked annoyed: "Why are you so stubborn? Cleaning this thing is just about right, so who can show you if you do it seriously?" "Damn, I am really annoyed by this place. If my father hadn't stopped my credit card for me, I would have been so stupid.If you force me to join the army, I won't come here to suffer." "We are fellow villagers.Don't say that I won't take care of you. Give me your retirement pay and we can start a business together.I have connections and I will make a lot of money for you!" Lu Yang was amused. He had just joined the army and he was already eyeing his retirement pay?"No, I don't plan to retire after serving as a soldier for two years." "What, are you really planning to stay here for a long time?" Ding Tengfei said in an experienced tone, gesticulating."Let's not talk about whether you can pass the exam. Even if you pass it, what will happen?" "What kind of future can you have as a junior officer? Do you have to retire when you are old?" "It is better to start a business as soon as possible. I haven't even finished junior high school, and now I still drive a Land Rover." "I have already thought about it. When I go out, I will open a milk tea shop first.This thing is a hot topic now, and it is a huge profit industry.A few cents of pearl milk tea can be sold for six or seven yuan!" "Otherwise, you can open a barber shop. Several of my brothers are studying beauty and hairdressing.Not only does this thing bring money, but girls also make money, especially if it is opened near the technical school!" Ding Tengfei puffed on his cigarette and showed a sly smile.Nowadays, before smart phones have appeared, it is an era when non-mainstream is domineering."If you break my wings, I will destroy your paradise" is the most popular saying at the moment.An exaggerated banged-up asshole hair is the standard feature for young boys; as for girls, they pursue straight bangs, tin foil perm, positioning perm, and linen dye perm.Because of this, Teacher Tony has become a trendsetter who is at the forefront of fashion, and naturally there are many young and rebellious girls who can come into contact with him.When Lu Yang looked at these things from the perspective of someone who had experienced them, he felt like he was suffering from shame and had goosebumps everywhere.Especially when he clicked on his QQ space and looked at the articles about Zhong Er Martian, he had the urge to slap himself twice... "I'm not interested in anything you said. I just want to be my soldier." "Whatever you want, I have good intentions anyway, you can't seize the opportunity.Yes, don't blame me." Ding Tengfei shrugged, feeling that Lu Yang still lacked structure, so he didn't dare to take that step bravely: "By the way, you should have less contact with Kong Long in the future, I think that idiot is unhappy!" Lu Yang was directly amused by him: Is there a possibility that I think you, an idiot, are also unhappy?The thinking of an adult has made him develop the habit of keeping his emotions and anger hidden.Since you know what kind of virtue the other party has, there is no need to pay attention to it.The best way to deal with this kind of people is to ignore them, because the more you talk to them, the more enthusiastic they will become.At this time, there was a sudden rush of footsteps outside. Ding Tengfei was so frightened that he quickly threw the cigarette butt into the tunnel, pretended to pick up the cleaning ball and began to wipe the floor tiles.But when he found out that the person coming was a recruit from the next class, he immediately put on a fierce look and cursed at the person."Damn it, you didn't see us doing sanitation here, go to the big toilet outside to poop!" "I, I just pee." "It's not okay to pee. I just wiped it clean. If you don't pass the inspection later, it's your fault?" The recruit was obviously an honest child, and he was so frightened that he quickly went to find a toilet elsewhere.In terms of protecting the fruits of labor, at least this guy did a pretty good job.But Lu Yang knew that this guy was not out of loyalty, but just wanted to share the fruits of his labor.... At the end of the sanitation work, Lu Yang was so tired that he was sweating all over, and Ding Tengfei, in order to show the hard work, also forcibly sprinkled some water on his head and collar.I have to say that this guy is quite clever and knows when to be lazy and when to show off.When walking back, class monitor Zhou Kaidong had already put on white gloves and began to check the hygiene situation in the dormitory.Just wipe it with your finger on the door and behind the bed board, and the white fingertips immediately turn gray.Zhou Kaidong snorted coldly: "This is the result of your cleaning. You have worked hard to give me such a result in an hour?" "Report!" Just as Kong Long and others were tremblingly waiting to be criticized, Lu Yang and Ding Tengfei happened to come back from outside.Zhou Kaidong didn't look back: "Come in!" But just as the two passed by him, Zhou Kaidong smelled something with his nose and immediately ordered the two to stop.He got between the two of them, smelled it, and asked coldly: "Did you smoke?" Ding Tengfei immediately denied it: "Report, I didn't smoke it!" Zhou Kaidong narrowed his eyes and looked at Lu Yang.Lu Yang: "Report, I don't have the habit of smoking." He did smoke in his previous life, but later he owed a lot of debt, so he borrowed it.If you force it on you, you can smoke it, but it's basically not addictive.Zhou Kaidong didn't waste any time, he directly targeted Ding Tengfei and ordered him to open his mouth and take a breath.But this guy was very thief. After smoking, he rinsed his mouth with water several times. There was no smell of smoke anymore.But Zhou Kaidong's next move directly exposed Ding Tengfei's true colors. He grabbed the other's fingers and smelled them. It was a fresh and mellow nicotine smell."Ding Tengfei stays, and the others go to the corridor and stand." "Yes!" Kong Long was lucky to have escaped, and quickly pushed Lu Yang out.He was very considerate and closed the dormitory door.Looking through the crack in the door that was about to close, looking at Ding Tengfei's retreating steps and his pale and frightened face, Lu Yang had already guessed what was going to happen next.[New knowledge point detected: Lift up!】【Analysis of knowledge points: In a broad sense, it refers to promotion from a soldier to an officer cadre. Another meaning is on the physical level, which is similar to the hanging bar!]...A few minutes later, the dormitory door was opened again.Zhou Kaidong walked out while wearing his armed belt.Lu Yang and others peeked into the door and gasped when they saw that the big red flower on the ground that had been gloriously enlisted had been ravaged and deformed.Don't use anything as a thorn, don't offend the squad leader with anything, don't smoke with anything, otherwise you will end up in a miserable situation... Zhou Kaidong snorted coldly: "Take your quilt and roll it to the corridor, and then I will teach you how to clean up the house, and move quickly!"
